reply_text:
I found no forward-looking, dated AI prediction by Shane Legg from 2019.

- **What I checked:** I ran the three fixed searches exactly as written, then seven more searches aimed at likely 2019 occasions. I opened two pages.
- **His 2019 public record is thin.** He was made a CBE in the 2019 Birthday Honours. He posted a June 2019 tweet that only praised someone else's AGI talk; I saw it in search results but didn't open it.
- **DeepMind: The Podcast, Episode 7 "Towards the future" (10 Sept 2019):** Legg isn't listed among the people interviewed. His 2010 talk and his paper with Hutter appear only under "further reading". The episode page I opened came back empty, so I can't confirm whether he speaks in it.
- **The Waikato Distinguished Alumni lecture was in 2018,** not 2019.
- **Things that point to 2019 but were said in other years:** On 31 December 2011 he wrote that he expected "an impressive proto-AGI within the next 8 years", which points to about 2019. I read this quote in a LessWrong comment that reproduces his blog post, not on his own blog. His 2011 LessWrong Q&A, his tweets from 2021 and 2025, and the 2023 coverage are all outside this year.
